name: Seamless Manufacturing
old_description: For more than 15 years, we have been serving our customers in Riverside, CA and the entire USA with premium printing services that include embroidery, screen printing, Direct To Garment (DTG) and more! Whether you need a large batch of t-shirts for your business or another collection for your clothing line, we have got you covered.
about:
Seamless Manufacturing operates from Riverside, California, where it has provided apparel decoration services for over 15 years. The company was founded to offer premium printing services including embroidery, screen printing, and direct-to-garment (DTG) printing to businesses and clothing brands across the United States.

The shop specializes in garment decoration through embroidery, screen printing, and DTG printing, complemented by folding and poly-bagging services. It sells packaged deals for bulk orders such as 50-piece t-shirt, oversized tee, and baseball cap bundles, with options for multi-color prints. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Customers range from local businesses needing branded uniforms to independent clothing lines launching collections. The company serves the broader U.S. market from its Riverside base, handling orders for corporate merchandise, promotional apparel, and private-label streetwear.

Seamless Manufacturing emphasizes attention to every production step, from printing precision to final packaging, aiming to exceed client expectations with each order. The team highlights its folding and poly-bagging service as a value-added differentiator for clients requiring retail-ready goods.
